<br>
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 17: Wild Card Qualifier''' was the tournament held on January 23rd, 2024 to determine the seed for the [[AfreecaTV_StarCraft_League_Remastered/17|AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 17]] due to [[EffOrt]] deciding not to participate, due to a wrist injury.
